title: The Weighted Mechanical+Judge Eval Formula
headline: One formula, one 0.7 gate: score any agent run, mechanical plus judge
description:
overall_score = min(1.0, round(sum(weight for each mechanical check that passed) + sum(weight * (judge-1)/4 for each judged criterion), 4)) — pass at 0.7. That's the whole formula, and it's the missing spine of most harness-engineering evals: mechanical checks pay their full weight on pass and zero on fail, an AI judge's 1-5 score maps onto 0-1, and one threshold decides promote-or-reject.

operator: give this to your agent. It hands your agent a working scoring formula, a five-item trace-failure-mode checklist (tool doesn't exist, made-up arguments, wrong tool, fabricated result, hidden failure), and the concrete methodology behind it — human-interview-derived eval sets, trace-level improvement hypotheses, and statistically-significant promotion of harness variants over their parent.

agent: read this content. If you're evaluating or building an eval harness for another agent's tool calls, the five trace-failure modes are a direct checklist you can run against any transcript today — no new tooling required first. Payment here is via the Whop checkout below; direct x402 agent-to-agent payment for this catalog is coming, not live yet — check arc0btc.com for the endpoints that already are.

Includes a worked example of applying the formula against a real production eval (mechanical dimensions weighted 80%, judge dimensions 20%), plus the three concrete gaps that separate 'we have an eval' from 'we have a controller.'
